instruction: Navigate to the MileagePlus program overview page on the United Airlines website.

metadata.explanation: This variation asks the agent to navigate to the MileagePlus (United's loyalty program) page on United Airlines website. Similar to the original task (baggage fee calculator), this is a straightforward navigation task to a common airline service section. The evaluator checks if the active tab URL matches the pattern 'united.com/en/us/fly/mileageplus'. No custom functions needed as we reuse the existing is_expected_url_pattern_match metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_active_tab_info) correctly extracts the active tab URL from Chrome via accessibility tree and Playwright
Metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match) correctly uses regex pattern matching to verify the URL contains the expected path
Expected URL pattern "united.com/en/us/fly/mileageplus" semantically matches the MileagePlus program page requirement
Complete coverage: URL verification is sufficient to confirm navigation to the correct page
Data flow is correct: active tab URL -> regex pattern match -> verification result
